elements.quote: Based on PICO, the present meta-analysis assessed the effect of treatment with PI compared with control groups (including both placebo and chlorhexidine) in preventing VAP among adult patients admitted to the ICU with mechanical ventilation.
elements.reason: Explicitly states the review objective using the PICO framework.

elements.quote: Based on PICO, the present meta-analysis assessed the effect of treatment with PI compared with control groups (including both placebo and chlorhexidine) in preventing VAP among adult patients admitted to the ICU with mechanical ventilation.
elements.reason: Explicitly states the planned comparison using the PICO framework for the intervention review.

elements.quote: Full-length, peer-reviewed published studies with RCT design with a primary focus on evaluating the clinical efficacy of oral care with PI compared with control groups (including using placebo or other antibacterial mouth rinses or methods for oral care) in prevention of VAP among adult patients admitted to the ICU with mechanical ventilation were included.
elements.reason: Specifies study design, settings, and intervention, but follow-up requirements are not mentioned.

elements.quote: Full-length, peer-reviewed published studies
elements.reason: Publication status is specified, but dissemination year and language are not mentioned.

elements.quote: 8 studies were removed due to inappropriate study design or outcomes, and one was removed due to a lack of desired information.
elements.reason: No clear distinction between exclusion due to outcomes not measured and outcomes not reported.
